name: Central Valley (Tulare Basin)
literature_sources: Neely et al. (2021), Water Resources Research
Ojha, Werth & Shirzaei (2019), JGR Solid Earth
Peacock et al. (2024) NASA NISAR StoryMap / UAVSAR
agreement_note: 108-day summer LOS peak (-7.8 cm; -10.1 cm vertical est.) matches upper drought literature; 11-month mixed full-year chain at Earlimart separates -16.8 cm/yr permanent LOS from 5.8 cm seasonal amplitude and agrees with 10 NGL GPS stations (RMSE 1.0 cm, r=0.68). Ref sensitivity ratio is 0.40 (>=0.30).
press_summary_gate_note: Approved for press summary with explicit LOS/vertical est., 108-day summer vs 11-month full-year permanent distinction, and GPS RMSE 1.0 cm.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: Airborne L-band UAVSAR mapped Central Valley (2013-2017) in NASA NISAR StoryMap; no peer-reviewed spaceborne NISAR time-series paper found as of 2026-11-14.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.
